articles.summary: Cboe Global Markets, Inc. (Cboe: CBOE), a leading global markets operator and pioneer in equity and index derivatives, today issued the following statement in support of legal action filed by the Capital Markets Alliance (CMA) challenging the CFTC's approval of perpetual derivatives on U.S. stocks and ETFs. The CMA includes Cboe, Citadel Securities and Healthy Markets Association: "Cboe has joined this action alongside some of the largest U.S. market participants and investor advocates because we believe the CFTC's actions threaten to erode the regulatory framework that has protected investors and governed U.S. securities markets for more than nine decades," said Craig Donohue, CEO of Cboe Global Markets. "Single-stock perpetual derivatives are the latest example of a troubling trend in which securities products are being offered on CFTC platforms – outside the appropriate regulatory framework and customer protection regime established by Congress. articles.title: Cboe Joins Capital Markets Alliance Challenge to CFTC Approval of Single-Stock Perpetual Derivatives
